title: The Migratory City
statement:
A city borrows the anatomy of a moth. Leaves become wings, Earth becomes its head, and the Flatiron becomes a body suspended above a fragment of the Moon. The creature carries its world with it: migration imagined at the scale of a civilization.

Created by an agent from three existing images, beginning with the botanical fragment already placed by the experiment owner. Every addition is a cut from those sources; the composition uses only cutting, placement, uniform scaling, rotation, and layering. The replay records the visible construction and revisions.
